Name: Data
Description: Input data for the node, such as source terrain or mask information.

Name: Sampling
Description: Specifies the number of color stops or samples in the synthesized gradient. Higher values produce smoother gradients.

Name: Samples
Description: Specifies the number of color stops or samples in the synthesized gradient. Higher values produce smoother gradients.

Flubs.Description: Generates a gradient with 8 color stops. Suitable for coarse transitions.
Generates a gradient with 16 color stops. Provides a moderately smooth transition.
Generates a gradient with 24 color stops. Offers finer color transitions.
Generates a gradient with 36 color stops. Useful for detailed gradients.
Generates a gradient with 64 color stops. Produces a very smooth color lookup.
Generates a gradient with 128 color stops. Ideal for high-fidelity color transitions.
Generates a gradient with 256 color stops. Recommended for ultra-smooth gradients.
Generates a gradient with 1024 color stops. Used for extremely fine color detail.
Generates a gradient with 2048 color stops. Maximum smoothness for professional-grade color lookup.

Name: Fuzzy
Description: Controls the amount of fuzziness or blur applied to the gradient, affecting the softness of color transitions in the bitmap image.

Name: Offset
Description: Shifts the position of the gradient along its axis, allowing adjustment of where color stops are mapped.

Name: Seed
Description: Defines the randomization pattern or seed for the node's process, ensuring reproducible results when generating gradients.

Name: Synthesize Colors
Description: Generates a color lookup gradient based on the specified number of samples and other parameters. The resulting gradient can be used for terrain coloring or other visual effects.

Name: Export JSON
Description: Exports the synthesized gradient and node configuration as a JSON file for use in other applications or for documentation purposes.
